mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals improving consumer confidence and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for 2 consecutive quarters is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.
